description: Operational service levels and evidence weights used by services (no hardcoded numbers in code). dsarResponseHours (72 h) is the response time for data-subject requests (access / erasure) and is TO BE CONFIRMED BY TASCO LEGAL against Decree 13/2023/ND-CP and the Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15. quickRenewal sets when the customer app offers the 3-step quick renewal instead of the full 6-step flow.
